Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, Advocate

2. Mr. Rakesh Kumar Joshi, Brief Holder

3. This is an appeal against conviction. By 
the impugned judgment dated 20.11.2023, 
passed by learned Additional District & 
Sessions Judge/FTSC (POCSO), District 
Dehradun, in Special Sessions Trial No. 102 
of 2017, appellant has been convicted for 
offences punishable under Sections 376, 
120-B, 328 IPC and Section 4 of POCSO Act, 
and sentenced to undergo maximum 
punishment provided under Section 4 of the 
POCSO Act.

within time.

6. Admit.
7. Let Trial Court Record be summoned. 
8. List on 03.06.2024.
9. Objection to the bail application, if any, 
be filed in the meantime.
